lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你昨天去參加同事的婚禮，怎麼樣？
lines.simplified: 你昨天去参加同事的婚礼，怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zuótiān qù cānjiā tóngshì de hūnlǐ, zěnmeyàng?
lines.english: How was your colleague's wedding yesterday?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 一點也不開心。我穿了白襯衫跟黑褲子，好幾位客人把我看成了飯店的服務生，一直請我拿飲料。
lines.simplified: 一点也不开心。我穿了白衬衫跟黑裤子，好几位客人把我看成了饭店的服务生，一直请我拿饮料。
lines.pinyin: Yìdiǎnyěbù kāixīn. Wǒ chuān le bái chènshān gēn hēi kùzi, hǎojǐwèi kèrén bǎ wǒ kànchéng le fàndiàn de fúwùshēng, yìzhí qǐng wǒ ná yǐnliào.
lines.english: Not at all. I wore a white shirt and black trousers, and several guests took me for one of the hotel's waiters and kept asking me to bring them drinks.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 真的嗎？你平時穿得那麼休閒，難得穿得這麼帥，沒想到被誤會了。
lines.simplified: 真的吗？你平时穿得那么休闲，难得穿得这么帅，没想到被误会了。
lines.pinyin: Zhēnde ma? Nǐ píngshí chuān de nàme xiūxián, nán děichuān de zhème shuài, méixiǎngdào bèi wùhuì le.
lines.english: Really? You usually dress so casually; for once you look this sharp, and you get mistaken for someone else.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 下次我要穿出自己的風格。
lines.simplified: 下次我要穿出自己的风格。
lines.pinyin: Xiàcì wǒ yào chuān chū zìjǐ de fēnggé.
lines.english: Next time I'm going to dress in my own style.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的昨天在婚禮上遇到了什麼事？
prompt.simplified: 男的昨天在婚礼上遇到了什么事？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de zuótiān zài hūnlǐ shàng yùdào le shénme shì?
prompt.english: What happened to the man at the wedding yesterday?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他把客人看成了服務生
choices.simplified: 他把客人看成了服务生
choices.pinyin: Tā bǎ kèrén kànchéng le fúwùshēng.
choices.english: He took a guest for a waiter.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他得一直幫同事拿飲料
choices.simplified: 他得一直帮同事拿饮料
choices.pinyin: Tā de yìzhí bāng tóngshì ná yǐnliào.
choices.english: He had to keep fetching drinks for his colleague.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 客人以為他是服務生
choices.simplified: 客人以为他是服务生
choices.pinyin: Kèrén yǐwéi tā shì fúwùshēng.
choices.english: The guests thought he was a waiter.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 同事說他穿得太休閒
choices.simplified: 同事说他穿得太休闲
choices.pinyin: Tóngshì shuō tā chuān de tài xiūxián.
choices.english: His colleague said he was dressed too casually.

questions.why: 好幾位客人把我看成了飯店的服務生: the guests mistook him for a waiter, so they kept asking him for drinks. It was not he who mistook anyone, the drinks were for guests, not a colleague, and 穿得那麼休閒 is what the woman says about his usual clothes.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你這個背包好好看，是名牌的吧？
lines.simplified: 你这个背包好好看，是名牌的吧？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zhège bēibāo hǎohǎo kàn, shì míngpái de ba?
lines.english: Your backpack looks great. It's a brand name, isn't it?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 不是，這是在夜市買的平價背包，才三百塊。
lines.simplified: 不是，这是在夜市买的平价背包，才三百块。
lines.pinyin: Bú shì, zhè shì zài yèshì mǎi de píngjià bēibāo, cái sān bǎi kuài.
lines.english: No, it's a cheap backpack I bought at the night market, just three hundred dollars.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 真的看不出來！
lines.simplified: 真的看不出来！
lines.pinyin: Zhēnde kàn bù chūlái!
lines.english: You really can't tell!

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 上次我媽媽也把它看成了名牌，還說我亂花錢。我跟她說了半天，她才相信。所以有沒有品味，跟花多少錢真的沒關係。
lines.simplified: 上次我妈妈也把它看成了名牌，还说我乱花钱。我跟她说了半天，她才相信。所以有没有品味，跟花多少钱真的没关系。
lines.pinyin: Shàngcì wǒ māma yě bǎ tā kànchéng le míngpái, hái shuō wǒ luàn huā qián. Wǒ gēn tā shuō le bàntiān, tā cái xiāngxìn. Suǒyǐ yǒu méi yǒu pǐnwèi, gēn huā duōshǎo qián zhēnde méi guānxi.
lines.english: Last time my mom took it for a brand name too, and said I was wasting money. I explained for ages before she believed me. So whether you have taste really has nothing to do with how much you spend.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 他媽媽上次為什麼不高興？
prompt.simplified: 他妈妈上次为什么不高兴？
prompt.pinyin: Tā māma shàngcì wèishénme bù gāoxìng?
prompt.english: Why was the man's mother unhappy last time?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 以為他花了很多錢買背包
choices.simplified: 以为他花了很多钱买背包
choices.pinyin: Yǐwéi tā huā le hěn duō qián mǎi bēibāo.
choices.english: She thought he had spent a lot on the backpack.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 以為背包是在夜市買的
choices.simplified: 以为背包是在夜市买的
choices.pinyin: Yǐwéi bēibāo shì zài yèshì mǎi de.
choices.english: She thought the backpack came from the night market.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 覺得平價的背包品質不好
choices.simplified: 觉得平价的背包品质不好
choices.pinyin: Juéde píngjià de bēibāo pǐnzhí bù hǎo.
choices.english: She felt cheap backpacks are poorly made.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 覺得他買的背包不好看
choices.simplified: 觉得他买的背包不好看
choices.pinyin: Juéde tā mǎi de bēibāo bù hǎokàn.
choices.english: She felt the backpack he bought looked bad.

questions.why: She took the cheap backpack for a brand name (把它看成了名牌) and so said he was wasting money. That it came from the night market is what he had to explain to her, and nobody says it is badly made or ugly: the woman says it looks great.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 聽說你們新公司對穿著沒什麼限制，很自由吧？
lines.simplified: 听说你们新公司对穿着没什么限制，很自由吧？
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō nǐmen xīn gōngsī duì chuānzhuó méi shénme xiànzhì, hěn zìyóu ba?
lines.english: I hear your new company has hardly any rules about clothes. That must feel free.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 是啊。我以前天天穿襯衫，穿慣了，現在穿得太休閒，覺得不自在。
lines.simplified: 是啊。我以前天天穿衬衫，穿惯了，现在穿得太休闲，觉得不自在。
lines.pinyin: Shì a. Wǒ yǐqián tiāntiān chuān chènshān, chuānguàn le, xiànzài chuān de tài xiūxián, juéde bú zìzài.
lines.english: Yes. I used to wear shirts every day. I got used to them, and now I feel uncomfortable dressing too casually.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那你就繼續穿襯衫啊。
lines.simplified: 那你就继续穿衬衫啊。
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐ jiù jìxù chuān chènshān a.
lines.english: Then just keep wearing shirts.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我也這麼想，可是同事都笑我，說我穿得像在銀行上班的人。
lines.simplified: 我也这么想，可是同事都笑我，说我穿得像在银行上班的人。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yě zhème xiǎng, kěshì tóngshì dōu xiào wǒ, shuō wǒ chuān de xiàng zài yínháng shàngbān de rén.
lines.english: That's what I thought, but my colleagues laugh and say I dress like someone who works at a bank.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的叫他繼續穿襯衫，男的在想什麼？
prompt.simplified: 女的叫他继续穿衬衫，男的在想什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de jiào tā jìxù chuān chènshān, nán de zài xiǎng shénme?
prompt.english: She suggests that he keep wearing shirts. What is he weighing up?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 穿慣了襯衫，又怕穿得太正式
choices.simplified: 穿惯了衬衫，又怕穿得太正式
choices.pinyin: Chuānguàn le chènshān, yòu pà chuān de tài zhèngshì.
choices.english: He is used to shirts but worries about looking too formal.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 喜歡穿襯衫，可是公司有限制
choices.simplified: 喜欢穿衬衫，可是公司有限制
choices.pinyin: Xǐhuān chuān chènshān, kěshì gōngsī yǒu xiànzhì.
choices.english: He likes shirts, but the company has rules about them.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 想穿得休閒，又怕同事笑他
choices.simplified: 想穿得休闲，又怕同事笑他
choices.pinyin: Xiǎng chuān de xiūxián, yòu pà tóngshì xiào tā.
choices.english: He wants to dress casually but fears his colleagues will laugh.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 想跟同事穿得一樣，又怕不好看
choices.simplified: 想跟同事穿得一样，又怕不好看
choices.pinyin: Xiǎng gēn tóngshì chuān de yíyàng, yòu pà bù hǎokàn.
choices.english: He wants to dress like his colleagues but worries it won’t look good.

questions.why: Casual clothes feel wrong because he is used to shirts. But when he wears a shirt, his colleagues tease him about looking like a banker.

focus.en: being used to something; concerns about what to wear

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 爸爸，我上個月送你的那件紅色外套，你怎麼都不穿？
lines.simplified: 爸爸，我上个月送你的那件红色外套，你怎么都不穿？
lines.pinyin: Bàba, wǒ shàng ge yuè sòng nǐ de nà jiàn hóngsè wàitào, nǐ zěnme dōu bù chuān?
lines.english: Dad, why do you never wear the red jacket I gave you last month?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 你去看看我的櫃子，哪一件有這麼亮？我穿慣了顏色深的。
lines.simplified: 你去看看我的柜子，哪一件有这么亮？我穿惯了颜色深的。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ qù kàn kàn wǒ de guìzi, nǎ yíjiàn yǒu zhème liàng? Wǒ chuānguàn le yánsè shēn de.
lines.english: Take a look in my wardrobe. Is anything in there this bright? I’m used to dark colours.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 可是你穿起來很帥啊，一點也不醜。
lines.simplified: 可是你穿起来很帅啊，一点也不丑。
lines.pinyin: Kěshì nǐ chuān qǐlái hěn shuài a, yìdiǎnyěbù chǒu.
lines.english: But you look really handsome in it, not ugly at all.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好吧，那這個星期天去你阿姨家，我就穿那件試試看。
lines.simplified: 好吧，那这个星期天去你阿姨家，我就穿那件试试看。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo ba, nà zhège xīngqítiān qù nǐ āyí jiā, wǒ jiù chuān nà jiàn shì shì kàn.
lines.english: All right, then this Sunday when we go to your aunt's, I'll try wearing it.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 聽了女兒的話，爸爸最後打算怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 听了女儿的话，爸爸最后打算怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Tīng le nǚér dehuà, bàba zuìhòu dǎsuàn zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: After listening to his daughter, what does the father decide to do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 先換一件顏色深的外套
choices.simplified: 先换一件颜色深的外套
choices.pinyin: Xiān huàn yíjiàn yánsè shēn de wàitào.
choices.english: He will change back into a dark jacket before leaving.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 試試平常不穿的顏色
choices.simplified: 试试平常不穿的颜色
choices.pinyin: Shì shì píngcháng bù chuān de yánsè.
choices.english: He will try a colour he does not normally wear.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 請女兒幫他換一件外套
choices.simplified: 请女儿帮他换一件外套
choices.pinyin: Qǐng nǚér bāng tā huàn yíjiàn wàitào.
choices.english: He will ask his daughter to exchange the jacket.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 再選一件外套送給阿姨
choices.simplified: 再选一件外套送给阿姨
choices.pinyin: Zài xuǎn yíjiàn wàitào sòng gěi āyí.
choices.english: He will pick another jacket as a gift for the aunt.

questions.why: The wardrobe and his remark about dark clothes establish his habit. After his daughter says he looks good, he agrees to try the bright jacket on their visit.

focus.en: being used to something; change of plan

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這件外套只有今天便宜一半，我非買不可！
lines.simplified: 这件外套只有今天便宜一半，我非买不可！
lines.pinyin: Zhè jiàn wàitào zhǐyǒu jīntiān piányí yíbàn, wǒ fēi mǎi bù kě!
lines.english: This jacket is half price today only. I have to buy it!

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳冷靜一點。妳的櫃子裡不是已經有三件差不多的嗎？
lines.simplified: 你冷静一点。你的柜子里不是已经有三件差不多的吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ lěngjìng yìdiǎn. Nǐ de guìzi lǐ bú shì yǐjīng yǒu sān jiàn chàbùduō de ma?
lines.english: Calm down. Don't you already have three jackets just like it in your wardrobe?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 可是這件是今年最流行的樣式。
lines.simplified: 可是这件是今年最流行的样式。
lines.pinyin: Kěshì zhè jiàn shì jīnnián zuì liúxíng de yàngshì.
lines.english: But this one is this year's most fashionable style.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 流行很快就過去了。妳先回家看看那三件，要是真的需要，晚上再來買也來得及。
lines.simplified: 流行很快就过去了。你先回家看看那三件，要是真的需要，晚上再来买也来得及。
lines.pinyin: Liúxíng hěn kuài jiù guòqù le. Nǐ xiān huí jiā kàn kàn nà sān jiàn, yàoshì zhēnde xūyào, wǎnshàng zài lái mǎi yě láidejí.
lines.english: Fashions pass quickly. Go home and look at those three first; if you really need it, there's still time to come back and buy it tonight.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的建議女的怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 男的建议女的怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de jiànyì nǚ de zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What does the man advise the woman to do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 今天先把這件外套買下來
choices.simplified: 今天先把这件外套买下来
choices.pinyin: Jīntiān xiān bǎ zhè jiàn wàitào mǎi xiàlái.
choices.english: Buy this jacket today first.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 等過幾天比較便宜再來買
choices.simplified: 等过几天比较便宜再来买
choices.pinyin: Děng guò jǐ tiān bǐjiào piányí zài lái mǎi.
choices.english: Wait a few days until it is cheaper, then buy it.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 先看看家裡的外套再決定
choices.simplified: 先看看家里的外套再决定
choices.pinyin: Xiān kàn kàn jiā lǐ de wàitào zài juédìng.
choices.english: Look at the jackets at home before deciding.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 換一件不一樣的樣式
choices.simplified: 换一件不一样的样式
choices.pinyin: Huàn yíjiàn bù yíyàng de yàngshì.
choices.english: Pick a jacket in a different style.

questions.why: He tells her to look at the three jackets she has first and come back tonight only if she really needs it. Buying today is her plan, not his advice; the discount is for today only, and he says she can come back tonight, not in a few days, and nobody suggests another style.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 明天見日本公司的人，我非穿得那麼正式不可嗎？天氣這麼熱。
lines.simplified: 明天见日本公司的人，我非穿得那么正式不可吗？天气这么热。
lines.pinyin: Míngtiānjiàn Rìběn gōngsī de rén, wǒ fēi chuān de nàme zhèngshì bù kě ma? Tiānqì zhème rè.
lines.english: Tomorrow, when we meet the people from the Japanese company, do I really have to dress so formally? It's so hot.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 當然。這是我們第一次跟他們合作，你的穿著就代表我們公司，不能穿得太休閒。
lines.simplified: 当然。这是我们第一次跟他们合作，你的穿着就代表我们公司，不能穿得太休闲。
lines.pinyin: Dāngrán. Zhè shì wǒmen dìyīcì gēn tāmen hézuò, nǐ de chuānzhuó jiù dàibiǎo wǒmen gōngsī, bù néng chuān de tài xiūxián.
lines.english: Of course. It's our first time working with them; what you wear stands for our company, so you can't be too casual.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好吧。可是我那套顏色深的，去年就穿不下了。
lines.simplified: 好吧。可是我那套颜色深的，去年就穿不下了。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo ba. Kěshì wǒ nà tào yánsè shēn de, qùnián jiù chuānbúxià le.
lines.english: All right. But my dark suit stopped fitting me last year.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那你今天下班就去買一套，別等到明天早上。
lines.simplified: 那你今天下班就去买一套，别等到明天早上。
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐ jīntiān xiàbān jiù qù mǎi yítào, bié děng dào míngtiān zǎoshàng.
lines.english: Then go buy one after work today. Don’t wait until tomorrow morning.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼認為男的得穿得正式？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么认为男的得穿得正式？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme rènwéi nán de děichuān de zhèngshì?
prompt.english: Why does the woman think the man must dress formally?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 日本公司要大家穿得正式
choices.simplified: 日本公司要大家穿得正式
choices.pinyin: Rìběn gōngsī yào dàjiā chuān de zhèngshì.
choices.english: The Japanese company asks everyone to dress formally.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 第一次跟客人見面都得穿新衣服
choices.simplified: 第一次跟客人见面都得穿新衣服
choices.pinyin: Dì yī cì gēn kèrén jiànmiàn dōu děi chuān xīn yīfu.
choices.english: You should always wear new clothes the first time you meet clients.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 兩家公司已經合作很久了
choices.simplified: 两家公司已经合作很久了
choices.pinyin: Liǎng jiā gōngsī yǐjīng hézuò hěn jiǔ le.
choices.english: The two companies have worked together for a long time.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他的穿著會影響公司給人的感覺
choices.simplified: 他的穿着会影响公司给人的感觉
choices.pinyin: Tā de chuānzhuó huì yǐngxiǎng gōngsī gěi rén de gǎnjué.
choices.english: What he wears shapes how people see the company.

questions.why: She says 你的穿著就代表我們公司: the visitors will judge the company by what he wears. Nobody says the Japanese side asked for it, he must buy a new suit only because the old one no longer fits, and this is their first time working together.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你去日本玩十天，只帶這個小背包？衣服夠穿嗎？
lines.simplified: 你去日本玩十天，只带这个小背包？衣服够穿吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ qù Rìběn wán shí tiān, zhǐ dài zhège xiǎo bēibāo? Yīfu gòu chuān ma?
lines.english: You're going to Japan for ten days with only this little backpack? Will you have enough clothes?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我只帶三件上衣，在那邊洗一洗就好了。當背包客，方便最重要。
lines.simplified: 我只带三件上衣，在那边洗一洗就好了。当背包客，方便最重要。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ dài sān jiàn shàngyī, zài nàbiān xǐ yì xǐ jiù hǎole. Dāng bēibāokè, fāngbiàn zuì zhòngyào.
lines.english: I'm only taking three tops; I'll wash them there. For a backpacker, travelling light matters most.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 話說回來，你不是要在那裡參加朋友的婚禮嗎？
lines.simplified: 话说回来，你不是要在那里参加朋友的婚礼吗？
lines.pinyin: Huà shuō huí lái, nǐ bú shì yào zài nàlǐ cānjiā péngyǒu de hūnlǐ ma?
lines.english: Then again, aren't you going to a friend's wedding there?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 對！我差點忘了，那還得帶一套正式一點的衣服。
lines.simplified: 对！我差点忘了，那还得带一套正式一点的衣服。
lines.pinyin: Duì! Wǒ chà diǎn wàngle, nà háiděi dài yítào zhèngshì yìdiǎn de yīfu.
lines.english: Right! I nearly forgot. Then I'll have to take a more formal outfit too.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的說「話說回來」，是想讓男的想到什麼？
prompt.simplified: 女的说「话说回来」，是想让男的想到什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de shuō "huà shuō huí lái", shì xiǎng ràng nán de xiǎngdào shénme?
prompt.english: When the woman says 話說回來, what does she want the man to think of?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 十天的衣服一定不夠
choices.simplified: 十天的衣服一定不够
choices.pinyin: Shí tiān de yīfu yídìng bú gòu.
choices.english: Ten days of clothes will surely not be enough.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 在那邊洗衣服不方便
choices.simplified: 在那边洗衣服不方便
choices.pinyin: Zài nàbiān xǐ yīfu bù fāngbiàn.
choices.english: Washing clothes there will be a hassle.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 小背包放不下三件上衣
choices.simplified: 小背包放不下三件上衣
choices.pinyin: Xiǎo bēibāo fàng bú xià sān jiàn shàngyī.
choices.english: Three tops will not fit in the small backpack.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 有一天他得穿得正式
choices.simplified: 有一天他得穿得正式
choices.pinyin: Yǒu yìtiān tā děichuān de zhèngshì.
choices.english: He has to dress formally on one of the days.

questions.why: 話說回來 turns to the other side of his plan: casual tops are fine, but there is a wedding, so he needs one formal outfit. She never says the clothes are too few or that washing is hard, and he is taking the three tops in that backpack.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 明天去花蓮，我想穿這雙新買的白球鞋。
lines.simplified: 明天去花莲，我想穿这双新买的白球鞋。
lines.pinyin: Míngtiān qù Huālián, wǒ xiǎng chuān zhè shuāng xīn mǎi de bái qiúxié.
lines.english: Tomorrow in Hualien I want to wear these new white sneakers.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 氣象預報說會下大雨，萬一弄髒了怎麼辦？還是穿舊的那雙吧。
lines.simplified: 气象预报说会下大雨，万一弄脏了怎么办？还是穿旧的那双吧。
lines.pinyin: Qìxiàng yùbào shuō huì xià dà yǔ, wànyī nòng zāng le zěnmebàn? Háishì chuān jiù de nà shuāng ba.
lines.english: The weather forecast says heavy rain. What if they get dirty? Better wear the old pair.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 舊的那雙太醜了，拍照不好看。
lines.simplified: 旧的那双太丑了，拍照不好看。
lines.pinyin: Jiù de nà shuāng tài chǒu le, pāi zhào bù hǎokàn.
lines.english: The old pair is too ugly; they'll look bad in photos.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那就把新的放在背包裡，到了再換。
lines.simplified: 那就把新的放在背包里，到了再换。
lines.pinyin: Nà jiù bǎ xīn de fàng zài bēibāo lǐ, dào le zài huàn.
lines.english: Then put the new ones in your backpack and change when you get there.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的最後建議男的怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 女的最后建议男的怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de zuìhòu jiànyì nán de zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: In the end, what does the woman suggest the man do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 穿舊的那雙鞋子去花蓮
choices.simplified: 穿旧的那双鞋子去花莲
choices.pinyin: Chuān jiù de nà shuāng xiézi qù Huālián.
choices.english: Wear the old pair to Hualien.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 帶著新鞋子去，到了再穿
choices.simplified: 带着新鞋子去，到了再穿
choices.pinyin: Dài zhe xīn xiézi qù, dào le zài chuān.
choices.english: Take the new shoes along and put them on there.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 等天氣好了再去花蓮
choices.simplified: 等天气好了再去花莲
choices.pinyin: Děng tiānqì hǎole zài qù Huālián.
choices.english: Go to Hualien when the weather is better.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 穿新鞋子去，拍完照再換
choices.simplified: 穿新鞋子去，拍完照再换
choices.pinyin: Chuān xīn xiézi qù, pāi wán zhào zài huàn.
choices.english: Wear the new shoes and change after the photos.

questions.why: Her first idea, 還是穿舊的那雙吧, is dropped when he says the old pair looks bad in photos; her last word is to carry the new pair and change when they arrive. Nobody suggests putting off the trip, and the new shoes are not worn on the way.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duì huà, ránhòu huídá liǎngge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a dialogue, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 下星期我要去那家公司談工作。我想買件名牌外套，穿起來比較有自信。
lines.simplified: 下星期我要去那家公司谈工作。我想买件名牌外套，穿起来比较有自信。
lines.pinyin: Xià xīngqí wǒ yào qù nà jiā gōngsī tán gōngzuò. Wǒ xiǎng mǎi jiàn míngpái wàitào, chuān qǐlái bǐjiào yǒu zìxìn.
lines.english: I’m going to that company about a job next week. I want to buy a brand-name jacket so I’ll feel more confident.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我覺得不必。他們看妳的能力跟態度，不是看牌子。況且他們做的是平價服裝，妳特地穿名牌去，人家可能以為妳不喜歡他們的衣服。
lines.simplified: 我觉得不必。他们看你的能力跟态度，不是看牌子。况且他们做的是平价服装，你特地穿名牌去，人家可能以为你不喜欢他们的衣服。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ juéde búbì. Tāmen kàn nǐ de nénglì gēn tàidù, bú shì kàn páizi. Kuàngqiě tāmen zuò de shì píngjià fúzhuāng, nǐ tèdì chuān míngpái qù, rén jiā kěnéng yǐwéi nǐ bù xǐhuān tāmen de yīfu.
lines.english: I don’t think you need to. They’re looking at your ability and attitude, not the label. Besides, they make affordable clothes. If you go out of your way to wear a brand name, they might think you don’t like their clothes.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 說得也是。那我穿什麼好？
lines.simplified: 说得也是。那我穿什么好？
lines.pinyin: Shuōdeyěshì. Nà wǒ chuān shénme hǎo?
lines.english: Fair point. So what should I wear?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 就穿妳平時那件白襯衫吧，乾淨又舒適。畢竟妳是去談工作，不是去參加時尚活動。
lines.simplified: 就穿你平时那件白衬衫吧，干净又舒适。毕竟你是去谈工作，不是去参加时尚活动。
lines.pinyin: Jiù chuān nǐ píngshí nà jiàn bái chènshān ba, gānjìng yòu shūshì. Bìjìng nǐ shì qù tán gōngzuò, bú shì qù cānjiā shíshàng huódòng.
lines.english: Just wear that white shirt you usually wear: clean and comfortable. After all, you're going to talk about a job, not to a fashion event.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好，那我把錢省下來，等找到工作再買。
lines.simplified: 好，那我把钱省下来，等找到工作再买。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, nà wǒ bǎ qián shěng xiàlái, děng zhǎo dào gōngzuò zài mǎi.
lines.english: OK, then I'll save the money and buy one when I've found a job.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的提到那家公司是做平價服裝的，是想說什麼？
prompt.simplified: 男的提到那家公司是做平价服装的，是想说什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de tídào nà jiā gōngsī shì zuò píngjià fúzhuāng de, shì xiǎng shuō shénme?
prompt.english: Why does the man mention that the company makes affordable clothing?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他們可能以為她不喜歡平價衣服
choices.simplified: 他们可能以为她不喜欢平价衣服
choices.pinyin: Tāmen kěnéng yǐwéi tā bù xǐhuān píngjià yīfu.
choices.english: They might think she dislikes affordable clothes.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他們可能以為她想買店裡的衣服
choices.simplified: 他们可能以为她想买店里的衣服
choices.pinyin: Tāmen kěnéng yǐwéi tā xiǎng mǎi diàn lǐ de yīfu.
choices.english: They might think she wants to buy the clothes they sell.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他們可能以為她是去參加活動
choices.simplified: 他们可能以为她是去参加活动
choices.pinyin: Tāmen kěnéng yǐwéi tā shì qù cānjiā huódòng.
choices.english: They might think she is there to attend an event.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他們可能以為她沒準備好
choices.simplified: 他们可能以为她没准备好
choices.pinyin: Tāmen kěnéng yǐwéi tā méi zhǔnbèi hǎo.
choices.english: They might think she is unprepared.

questions.why: He adds that the company sells affordable clothes. Seeing her make a point of wearing a brand name could give them the wrong idea about how she feels about their clothes.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 聽完建議以後，女的改變了什麼打算？
prompt.simplified: 听完建议以后，女的改变了什么打算？
prompt.pinyin: Tīng wán jiànyì yǐhòu, nǚ de gǎibiàn le shénme dǎsuàn?
prompt.english: After hearing the advice, how does the woman change her plans?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 先買件平價外套，名牌晚點買
choices.simplified: 先买件平价外套，名牌晚点买
choices.pinyin: Xiān mǎi jiàn píngjià wàitào, míngpái wǎn diǎn mǎi.
choices.english: Buy an affordable jacket now and a brand-name one later.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 先買名牌外套，下星期就穿
choices.simplified: 先买名牌外套，下星期就穿
choices.pinyin: Xiān mǎi míngpái wàitào, xià xīngqí jiù chuān.
choices.english: Buy a brand-name jacket now and wear it next week.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 先買件外套，再決定穿哪一件
choices.simplified: 先买件外套，再决定穿哪一件
choices.pinyin: Xiān mǎi jiàn wàitào, zài juédìng chuān nǎ yíjiàn.
choices.english: Buy a jacket first and then decide what to wear.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 先穿自己的襯衫，外套晚點買
choices.simplified: 先穿自己的衬衫，外套晚点买
choices.pinyin: Xiān chuān zìjǐ de chènshān, wàitào wǎn diǎn mǎi.
choices.english: Wear her own shirt and buy the jacket later.

questions.why: She accepts that this is about getting a job, so she can wear the white shirt she already has. She decides to hold off buying the jacket until she finds work.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duì huà, ránhòu huídá liǎngge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a dialogue, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 明天第一次跟他出去，我穿這件新買的洋裝好不好？
lines.simplified: 明天第一次跟他出去，我穿这件新买的洋装好不好？
lines.pinyin: Míngtiān dìyīcì gēn tā chūqù, wǒ chuān zhè jiàn xīn mǎi de yángzhuāng hǎo bù hǎo?
lines.english: Tomorrow is my first time going out with him. Shall I wear this new dress?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好看是好看，可是你們不是要去爬山嗎？況且這件是白色的，弄髒了很難洗。
lines.simplified: 好看是好看，可是你们不是要去爬山吗？况且这件是白色的，弄脏了很难洗。
lines.pinyin: Hǎokànshìhǎokàn, kěshì nǐmen bú shì yào qù pá shān ma? Kuàngqiě zhè jiàn shì báisè de, nòng zāng le hěn nán xǐ.
lines.english: It looks nice, sure, but aren't you two going hiking? Besides, it's white: once it's dirty it's hard to wash.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 不用說我也知道，你一定會叫我穿運動服。會不會太休閒？
lines.simplified: 不用说我也知道，你一定会叫我穿运动服。会不会太休闲？
lines.pinyin: Búyòngshuō wǒ yě zhīdào, nǐ yídìng huì jiào wǒ chuān yùndòngfú. Huì bú huì tài xiūxián?
lines.english: I know what you’re going to say: wear sportswear. Won’t that be too casual?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 不會啊。畢竟是去爬山，穿得舒適、自在最重要。他要是真的喜歡妳，也不會只看妳穿什麼。
lines.simplified: 不会啊。毕竟是去爬山，穿得舒适、自在最重要。他要是真的喜欢你，也不会只看你穿什么。
lines.pinyin: Bú huì a. Bìjìng shì qù pá shān, chuān de shūshì, zìzài zuì zhòngyào. Tā yàoshì zhēnde xǐhuān nǐ, yě bú huì zhǐ kàn nǐ chuān shénme.
lines.english: Not at all. After all, you're going hiking: being comfortable and at ease matters most. If he really likes you, he won't only look at what you're wearing.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你說得對。那這件洋裝留到下次去看電影再穿。
lines.simplified: 你说得对。那这件洋装留到下次去看电影再穿。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de duì. Nà zhè jiàn yángzhuāng liú dào xiàcì qù kàn diànyǐng zài chuān.
lines.english: You're right. I'll save this dress for when we go to a film next time.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的為什麼不建議女的穿那件洋裝？
prompt.simplified: 男的为什么不建议女的穿那件洋装？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de wèishénme bú jiànyì nǚ de chuān nà jiàn yángzhuāng?
prompt.english: Why does the man advise against the dress?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 洋裝的樣式不夠好看
choices.simplified: 洋装的样式不够好看
choices.pinyin: Yángzhuāng de yàngshì bú gòu hǎokàn.
choices.english: The dress is not stylish enough.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 第一次見面不必穿新衣服
choices.simplified: 第一次见面不必穿新衣服
choices.pinyin: Dìyīcì jiànmiàn búbì chuān xīn yīfu.
choices.english: A first date does not need new clothes.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 爬山不方便，髒了也難洗
choices.simplified: 爬山不方便，脏了也难洗
choices.pinyin: Pá shān bù fāngbiàn, zāng le yě nán xǐ.
choices.english: It’s inconvenient for hiking and hard to wash once dirty.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 洋裝應該留著看電影穿
choices.simplified: 洋装应该留着看电影穿
choices.pinyin: Yángzhuāng yīnggāi liú zhe kàn diànyǐng chuān.
choices.english: The dress should be kept for the cinema.

questions.why: Two reasons joined by 況且: they are going hiking, and a white dress is hard to wash once dirty. He says it looks nice (好看是好看), and saving it for the cinema is her idea at the end, not his reason.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 從女的最後的安排，可以知道她怎麼想？
prompt.simplified: 从女的最后的安排，可以知道她怎么想？
prompt.pinyin: Cóng nǚ de zuìhòu de ānpái, kěyǐ zhīdào tā zěnme xiǎng?
prompt.english: What does the woman’s final plan tell us about her thinking?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她覺得第一次出門要穿新衣服
choices.simplified: 她觉得第一次出门要穿新衣服
choices.pinyin: Tā juéde dìyīcì chūmén yào chuān xīn yīfu.
choices.english: She thinks she should wear something new on the first outing.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她覺得不同活動適合穿不同衣服
choices.simplified: 她觉得不同活动适合穿不同衣服
choices.pinyin: Tā juéde bùtóng huódòng shìhé chuān bùtóng yīfu.
choices.english: She thinks different activities call for different clothes.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她覺得兩次出門都能穿運動服
choices.simplified: 她觉得两次出门都能穿运动服
choices.pinyin: Tā juéde liǎng cì chūmén dōu néng chuān yùndòngfú.
choices.english: She thinks sportswear would suit both outings.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她覺得白色衣服不適合約會
choices.simplified: 她觉得白色衣服不适合约会
choices.pinyin: Tā juéde báisè yīfu bú shìhé yuēhuì.
choices.english: She thinks white clothes aren't right for a date.

questions.why: She worries that sportswear is too casual. The man says comfort matters on the hike, and she decides to keep the dress for the cinema instead, so her choice depends on the activity. She still keeps the white dress for a later date at the cinema, so white itself is not the problem.

focus.en: after all; a plan and its reason

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段說明，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段说明，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn shuōmíng, ránhòu huídá liǎngge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to an announcement, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 各位同學好，下星期三下午兩點，我們請到一位做服裝設計的老師來學校演講，談的是「找工作的時候怎麼穿」。
lines.simplified: 各位同学好，下星期三下午两点，我们请到一位做服装设计的老师来学校演讲，谈的是「找工作的时候怎么穿」。
lines.pinyin: Gè wèi tóngxué hǎo, xià xīngqísān xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn, wǒmen qǐng dào yíwèi zuò fúzhuāng shèjì de lǎoshī lái xuéxiào yǎn jiǎng, tán de shì "zhǎo gōngzuò de shíhòu zěnme chuān".
lines.english: Hello, everyone. Next Wednesday at two p.m., a teacher who works in fashion design is coming to give a talk at our school on "What to Wear When You Look for a Job".

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 一般來說，公司的人一見面就會對你有個看法。所謂穿得合適，跟你要去哪家公司有關。去銀行可以穿得正式一點，去設計公司可以穿出自己的風格。衣服再貴，穿得不自在，也很難對自己有信心。

passage.traditional: 去年冬天，一家快時尚公司跟明星{1}，明星選樣式，公司做外套。廣告晚上八點才{2}，七點多就有人在電視前等著看。第二天一大早就有人排隊，{3}有人前一天晚上就到了。我很想{4}最新的流行，可是平常沒空逛街，只能看廣告。不用花太多錢就能穿出明星的品味，是這些外套最大的{5}。我特地上街買了一件，穿了幾次才發現品質跟一般平價外套差不多。我不得不{6}，當時只是被廣告吸引了。
passage.simplified: 去年冬天，一家快时尚公司跟明星{1}，明星选样式，公司做外套。广告晚上八点才{2}，七点多就有人在电视前等着看。第二天一大早就有人排队，{3}有人前一天晚上就到了。我很想{4}最新的流行，可是平常没空逛街，只能看广告。不用花太多钱就能穿出明星的品味，是这些外套最大的{5}。我特地上街买了一件，穿了几次才发现品质跟一般平价外套差不多。我不得不{6}，当时只是被广告吸引了。
passage.pinyin: Qùnián dōngtiān, yìjiā kuàishíshàng gōngsī gēn míngxīng hézuò, míngxīng xuǎn yàngshì, gōngsī zuò wàitào. Guǎnggào wǎnshàng bā diǎn cái bòchū, qīdiǎnduō jiù yǒu rén zài diànshì qián děng zhe kàn. Dì èr tiān yídàzǎo jiù yǒu rén páiduì, shènzhì yǒu rén qián yìtiān wǎnshàng jiù dào le. Wǒ hěn xiǎng zhǎngwò zuì xīn de liúxíng, kěshì píngcháng méikòng guàngjiē, zhǐ néng kàn guǎnggào. Búyòng huā tài duō qián jiù néng chuān chū míngxīng de pǐnwèi, shì zhè xiē wàitào zuì dà de mèilì. Wǒ tèdì shàngjiē mǎi le yíjiàn, chuān le jǐ cì cái fāxiàn pǐnzhí gēn yìbān píngjià wàitào chàbùduō. Wǒ bùdébù chéngrèn, dāngshí zhǐshì bèi guǎnggào xīyǐn le.
passage.english: Last winter a fast-fashion company worked with a celebrity. The celebrity chose the styles and the company made the jackets. The ad was only shown at eight p.m., but from seven-something people were already in front of the TV waiting to see it. By early the next morning, people were lining up. Some had even arrived the night before. I really wanted to keep up with the latest fashions, but I usually have no time to go shopping and can only watch the adverts. The jackets’ biggest appeal was that I could dress with a celebrity’s taste without spending a lot. I made a special trip to buy one, only to find after a few wears that its quality was about the same as any affordable jacket. I have to admit I was just drawn in by the ad.

passage.traditional: 我跟姊姊對穿著的看法剛好{1}。姊姊穿衣服很{2}，出門前要花一小時，連鞋子的顏色也要跟衣服搭配。她{3}的鞋子超過三十雙，可是真正常穿的只有三、四雙。我{4}只穿球鞋跟牛仔褲，舒服就好。上個月，姊姊要去參加時尚活動，非要我陪她去不可。我本來不想去，因為我對時尚沒興趣，{5}那天晚上還有報告要寫。到了以後，我穿得跟大家不一樣，也不知道怎麼開口跟人說話，站在門口覺得很{6}。

Tā yǒngyǒu de xiézi chāoguò sān shí shuāng, kěshì zhēnzhèng cháng chuān de zhǐyǒu sān, sì shuāng. Wǒ píngshí zhǐ chuān qiúxié gēn niúzǎikù, shūfu jiù hǎo. Shàng ge yuè, zǐ zǐ yào qù cānjiā shíshàng huódòng, fēi yàowǒ péi tā qù bù kě. Wǒ běnlái bù xiǎng qù, yīnwèi wǒ duì shíshàng méi xìngqù, kuàngqiě nà tiān wǎnshàng háiyǒu bàogào yào xiě. Dào le yǐhòu, wǒ chuān de gēn dàjiā bù yíyàng, yě bù zhīdào zěnme kāi kǒu gēn rén shuōhuà, zhàn zài ménkǒu juéde hěn bú zìzài.
passage.english: My older sister and I see clothes in exactly opposite ways. She is very particular about what she wears. It takes her an hour to get ready, and even her shoes have to match her clothes. She owns more than thirty pairs of shoes but only really wears three or four. I usually wear sneakers and jeans. I’m happy as long as I’m comfortable. Last month my sister insisted I accompany her to a fashion event. I didn’t want to go because fashion doesn’t interest me, and besides, I had a report to write that evening. When we arrived, I was dressed differently from everyone else and didn’t know how to start talking to anyone. Standing by the door, I felt ill at ease.

text.traditional:
我叔叔在一家汽車公司負責賣車。他常說，跟客人見面的時候，穿著代表一個人的地位，所以他對穿著非常講究，天天穿名牌，連手錶都非買最貴的不可。一般來說，這種想法一點也不奇怪。很多公司花大錢請明星拍廣告，讓大家覺得擁有名牌，就是擁有成功的生活，這是很正常的商業作法。
可是我發現，叔叔賣得最好的時候，不是他穿得最貴的時候。有一次下大雨，他的衣服都濕了，還是冷靜、有耐心地回答客人的每一個問題，那位客人當天就買了一輛車。後來叔叔也承認，客人真正在意的，是他能不能把問題說明白、態度好不好。
我覺得，人應該當衣服的主人。名牌可以讓人一時覺得有自信，可是一個人的魅力，跟他穿什麼牌子的衣服無關。
text.simplified:
我叔叔在一家汽车公司负责卖车。他常说，跟客人见面的时候，穿着代表一个人的地位，所以他对穿着非常讲究，天天穿名牌，连手表都非买最贵的不可。一般来说，这种想法一点也不奇怪。很多公司花大钱请明星拍广告，让大家觉得拥有名牌，就是拥有成功的生活，这是很正常的商业作法。
可是我发现，叔叔卖得最好的时候，不是他穿得最贵的时候。有一次下大雨，他的衣服都湿了，还是冷静、有耐心地回答客人的每一个问题，那位客人当天就买了一辆车。后来叔叔也承认，客人真正在意的，是他能不能把问题说明白、态度好不好。
我觉得，人应该当衣服的主人。名牌可以让人一时觉得有自信，可是一个人的魅力，跟他穿什么牌子的衣服无关。
text.pinyin: Wǒ shúshu zài yìjiā qìchē gōngsī fùzé mài chē. Tā cháng shuō, gēn kèrén jiànmiàn de shíhòu, chuānzhuó dàibiǎo yígerén de dìwèi, suǒyǐ tā duì chuānzhuó fēicháng jiǎngjiù, tiāntiān chuān míngpái, lián shǒubiǎo dōu fēi mǎi zuì guì de bù kě. Yìbānláishuō, zhè zhǒng xiǎngfǎ yìdiǎnyěbù qíguài. Hěn duō gōngsī huā dà qián qǐng míngxīng pāi guǎnggào, ràng dàjiā juéde yǒngyǒu míngpái, jiùshì yǒngyǒu chénggōng de shēnghuó, zhè shì hěn zhèngcháng de shāngyè zuòfǎ. Kěshì wǒ fāxiàn, shúshu mài de zuìhǎo de shíhòu, bú shì tā chuān de zuì guì de shíhòu. Yǒu yícì xià dà yǔ, tā de yīfu dōu shī le, háishì lěngjìng, yǒu nàixīn de huídá kèrén de měi yíge wèntí, nà wèi kèrén dàngtiān jiù mǎi le yíliàng chē. Hòulái shúshu yě chéngrèn, kèrén zhēnzhèng zàiyì de, shì tā néng bù néng bǎ wèntí shuō míngbái, tàidù hǎo bù hǎo. Wǒ juéde, rén yīnggāi dāng yīfu de zhǔrén. Míngpái kěyǐ ràng rén yìshí juéde yǒu zìxìn, kěshì yígerén de mèilì, gēn tā chuān shénme páizi de yīfu wúguān.
text.english:
My uncle sells cars for a car company. He often says that when you meet customers, your clothes stand for your status, so he is very particular about clothes and wears brand names every day; even his watch has to be the most expensive. Generally speaking, this idea is not strange. Many companies spend a fortune on stars for their adverts to make people feel that owning brand names means owning a successful life, which is a normal business practice.
But I have noticed that my uncle sells best not when he is dressed most expensively. Once, in heavy rain, his clothes got soaked, yet he still answered every one of a customer's questions calmly and patiently, and the customer bought a car that same day. Later my uncle admitted that what customers really care about is whether he can explain their questions clearly and whether his attitude is good.
I think people should be the masters of their clothes. Brand names can make people feel confident for a while, but a person's charm has nothing to do with the label on their clothes.

text.traditional:
我們辦公室上個月來了一位新同事。一般來說，新同事都會穿得跟大家差不多，可是她的衣服顏色都很亮，樣式也很特別，而且她穿得很有自信。剛開始，大家都把她看成一個不好相處的人，中午吃飯也很少找她。有一天，她在電梯裡聽到兩位同事在討論她的衣服，就笑著說：「這些都是我自己做的。」原來她大學念的是服裝設計，週末還在網路上賣自己設計的衣服。從那天起，她的衣服成了辦公室裡大家最喜歡聊的話題，有的同事還請她幫忙選衣服。
這件事使我明白，一開始的誤會，只是因為大家不了解她。穿出屬於自己的風格，本來就是很自然的事。比起一個人穿什麼，更重要的是，我們肯不肯先花時間認識他。
text.simplified:
我们办公室上个月来了一位新同事。一般来说，新同事都会穿得跟大家差不多，可是她的衣服颜色都很亮，样式也很特别，而且她穿得很有自信。刚开始，大家都把她看成一个不好相处的人，中午吃饭也很少找她。有一天，她在电梯里听到两位同事在讨论她的衣服，就笑着说：「这些都是我自己做的。」原来她大学念的是服装设计，周末还在网路上卖自己设计的衣服。从那天起，她的衣服成了办公室里大家最喜欢聊的话题，有的同事还请她帮忙选衣服。
这件事使我明白，一开始的误会，只是因为大家不了解她。穿出属于自己的风格，本来就是很自然的事。比起一个人穿什么，更重要的是，我们肯不肯先花时间认识他。
text.pinyin: Wǒmen bàngōngshì shàng ge yuè lái le yíwèi xīn tóngshì. Yìbānláishuō, xīn tóngshì dōu huì chuān de gēn dàjiā chàbùduō, kěshì tā de yīfu yánsè dōu hěn liàng, yàngshì yě hěn tèbié, érqiě tā chuān dehěn yǒu zìxìn. Gāng kāishǐ, dàjiā dōu bǎ tā kànchéng yíge bù hǎo xiāngchǔ de rén, zhōngwǔ chī fàn yě hěn shǎo zhǎo tā. Yǒu yìtiān, tā zài diàntī lǐ tīng dào liǎng wèi tóngshì zài tǎolùn tā de yīfu, jiù xiào zhe shuō: "Zhè xiē dōu shì wǒ zìjǐ zuò de." yuánlái tā dàxué niàn de shì fúzhuāng shèjì, zhōumò hái zài wǎnglù shàng mài zìjǐ shèjì de yīfu. Cóng nà tiān qǐ, tā de yīfu chéng le bàngōngshì lǐ dàjiā zuì xǐhuān liáo dehuà tí, yǒude tóngshì hái qǐng tā bāngmáng xuǎn yīfu. Zhè jiàn shì shǐ wǒ míngbái, yìkāishǐ de wùhuì, zhǐshì yīnwèi dàjiā bùliǎo jiě tā. Chuān chū shǔyú zìjǐ de fēnggé, běnlái jiùshì hěn zìrán de shì. Bǐ qǐ yígerén chuān shénme, gèngzhòngyào de shì, wǒmen kěn bù kěn xiān huā shíjiān rènshì tā.
text.english:
Last month a new colleague joined our office. Generally speaking, new colleagues dress much like everyone else, but her clothes were all bright colours and unusual styles, and she wore them with great confidence. At first everyone took her for someone hard to get along with and seldom asked her to lunch. One day in the lift she heard two colleagues discussing her clothes, and she said with a smile, "I made all of these myself." It turned out she had studied fashion design at university and sells clothes she designs online at weekends. From that day on, her clothes became everyone's favourite topic in the office, and some colleagues even asked her to help them choose clothes.
This made me understand that the first misunderstanding was just because nobody knew her. Dressing in a style of one's own is a perfectly natural thing. More important than what someone wears is whether we are willing to take the time to get to know them first.

prompt.simplified: 同事对她的看法为什么改变了？

prompt.english: Why did the colleagues change their view of her?

choices.simplified: 她开始穿得跟大家一样

choices.english: She started dressing like everyone else.

choices.simplified: 知道了她自己会设计衣服

choices.english: They learned that she designs clothes herself.

choices.simplified: 她常请大家一起吃午饭

choices.english: She often invited everyone to lunch.

choices.traditional: 她幫每位同事選了衣服
choices.simplified: 她帮每位同事选了衣服
choices.pinyin: Tā bāng měi wèi tóngshì xuǎn le yīfu.
choices.english: She chose clothes for every colleague.

questions.why: The change starts in the lift, when she says she made the clothes, and the writer adds that she studied fashion design: once they knew, the clothes became a topic instead of a wall. She did not change how she dresses, lunch invitations were what she lacked, and helping some colleagues choose clothes came after the change.

choices.simplified: 大家后来想跟她一起做衣服

choices.traditional: 大家了解她以後，對她的態度改變了

questions.why: At first they misjudged her as hard to get along with and seldom asked her to lunch; once they knew her, some even asked her to help choose clothes. Set side by side, the two show their attitude changing after they understood her, as the writer says: 一開始的誤會，只是因為大家不了解她. She did not start listening to others, and nobody wants to dress like her or make clothes with her.

text.traditional: 我爸爸以前在銀行工作，天天穿襯衫跟皮鞋，忙得沒有休閒的時間。去年他退休了，總算可以做自己想做的事。他說年輕的時候最想學衝浪，可是一直沒時間。媽媽聽了說：「既然現在有時間了，就去試試看吧！」第一次下水，他一連掉進海裡十幾次，喝了好幾口海水，可是他一點也不想停下來。三個月以後，他總算能站在衝浪板上了。現在，他櫃子裡的襯衫越來越少，休閒的衣服越來越多，衝浪也使他變得比以前開朗。媽媽開玩笑說，認識他三十年，從來沒看過他這麼開心。
text.simplified: 我爸爸以前在银行工作，天天穿衬衫跟皮鞋，忙得没有休闲的时间。去年他退休了，总算可以做自己想做的事。他说年轻的时候最想学冲浪，可是一直没时间。妈妈听了说：「既然现在有时间了，就去试试看吧！」第一次下水，他一连掉进海里十几次，喝了好几口海水，可是他一点也不想停下来。三个月以后，他总算能站在冲浪板上了。现在，他柜子里的衬衫越来越少，休闲的衣服越来越多，冲浪也使他变得比以前开朗。妈妈开玩笑说，认识他三十年，从来没看过他这么开心。
text.pinyin: Wǒ bàba yǐqián zài yínháng gōngzuò, tiāntiān chuān chènshān gēn píxié, máng de méi yǒu xiūxián de shíjiān. Qùnián tā tuìxiū le, zǒngsuàn kěyǐ zuò zìjǐ xiǎng zuò de shì. Tā shuō niánqīng de shíhòu zuì xiǎng xué chōnglàng, kěshì yìzhí méi shíjiān. Māma tīng le shuō: "Jìrán xiànzài yǒu shíjiān le, jiù qù shì shì kàn ba!" dìyīcì xià shuǐ, tā yìlián diào jìn hǎi lǐ shí jǐ cì, hē le hǎojǐkǒu hǎi shuǐ, kěshì tā yìdiǎnyěbù xiǎng tíng xiàlái. Sānge yuè yǐhòu, tā zǒngsuàn néng zhàn zài chōnglàngbǎn shàng le. Xiànzài, tā guìzi lǐ de chènshān yuè lái yuè shǎo, xiūxián de yīfu yuè lái yuè duō, chōnglàng yě shǐ tā biàn de bǐ yǐqián kāilǎng. Māma kāiwánxiào shuō, rènshì tā sān shí nián, cónglái méi kàn guò tā zhème kāixīn.
text.english: My father used to work at a bank, in a shirt and leather shoes every day, too busy for any leisure. Last year he retired and at last could do what he wanted. He said that when he was young he most wanted to learn to surf, but never had the time. Hearing this, my mother said, "Since you have time now, go and give it a try!" The first time in the water he fell into the sea more than ten times in a row and swallowed several mouthfuls of seawater, but he did not want to stop at all. Three months later he could finally stand on a surfboard. Now there are fewer and fewer shirts in his wardrobe and more and more casual clothes, and surfing has made him more cheerful than before. My mother jokes that in thirty years of knowing him she has never seen him this happy.

text.traditional: 我阿姨在南部開了一家小服裝店，賣的都是平價的衣服。去年夏天來了一個強烈颱風，阿姨以為店的位置比較高，不會淹水，沒想到雨一連下了兩天，附近的河水都流進了店裡。第二天早上，放得比較低的衣服都濕了，有的甚至已經不能賣了。阿姨看著店裡的樣子，難過得說不出話來。附近的人知道以後，天天一下班就主動來幫忙整理，有人把濕衣服洗乾淨，有人在網路上幫她介紹這家店。結果，一個月以後，店又開了，來買衣服的人比以前還多。阿姨說，這場颱風讓她失去了很多，可是也讓她親眼看見了大家的力量。
text.simplified: 我阿姨在南部开了一家小服装店，卖的都是平价的衣服。去年夏天来了一个强烈台风，阿姨以为店的位置比较高，不会淹水，没想到雨一连下了两天，附近的河水都流进了店里。第二天早上，放得比较低的衣服都湿了，有的甚至已经不能卖了。阿姨看着店里的样子，难过得说不出话来。附近的人知道以后，天天一下班就主动来帮忙整理，有人把湿衣服洗干净，有人在网路上帮她介绍这家店。结果，一个月以后，店又开了，来买衣服的人比以前还多。阿姨说，这场台风让她失去了很多，可是也让她亲眼看见了大家的力量。
text.pinyin: Wǒ āyí zài nán bù kāi le yìjiā xiǎo fúzhuāng diàn, mài de dōu shì píngjià de yīfu. Qùnián xiàtiān lái le yíge qiángliè táifēng, āyí yǐwéi diàn de wèizhì bǐjiào gāo, bú huì yānshuǐ, méixiǎngdào yǔ yìlián xià le liǎng tiān, fùjìn de hé shuǐ dōu liú jìn le diàn lǐ. Dì èr tiān zǎoshàng, fàng de bǐjiào dī de yīfu dōu shī le, yǒude shènzhì yǐjīng bù néng mài le. Āyí kàn zhe diàn lǐ de yàngzi, nánguò de shuōbùchūhuàlái. Fùjìn de rén zhīdào yǐhòu, tiāntiān yíxiàbān jiù zhǔdòng lái bāngmáng zhěnglǐ, yǒu rén bǎ shī yīfu xǐ gānjìng, yǒu rén zài wǎnglù shàng bāng tā jièshào zhè jiā diàn. Jiéguǒ, yígeyuè yǐhòu, diàn yòu kāi le, lái mǎi yīfu de rén bǐ yǐqián hái duō. Āyí shuō, zhè chǎng táifēng ràng tā shīqù le hěn duō, kěshì yě ràng tā qīnyǎn kànjiàn le dàjiā de lìliàng.
text.english: My aunt runs a small clothes shop in the south, selling only affordable clothes. Last summer a strong typhoon came. She thought the shop stood fairly high and would not flood, but the rain fell for two days in a row and the water from the nearby river ran into the shop. The next morning the clothes kept low down were all wet, and some could not even be sold any more. Looking at the shop, my aunt was too upset to speak. When people nearby heard, they volunteered to help clean up every day after work: some washed the wet clothes, some introduced her shop online. As a result, a month later the shop opened again, and more people came to buy clothes than before. My aunt says the typhoon made her lose a lot, but it also let her see firsthand what people can do together.

questions.why: The higher location sets up her expectation that the shop will stay dry. The water entering the shop reverses that expectation. The text gives no reason for choosing the location and says the clothes were still down low. Nothing says the shop flooded before: she thought it stood high enough.

questions.why: 大家的力量 is what she saw: people nearby who came every day after work to wash clothes and promote the shop. More customers is the result (結果) of that help, not the 力量 itself, and the text mentions no staff or family helping.
